scope: bounded developer-only player movement input research

experiments.result: rejected: setter calls succeed but are not consumed as player movement

experiments.method: set_AxisL after UpdateHID for 60 frames, matching the bundled REFramework VR timing
experiments.result: rejected: post-HID timing does not reach the MHR player movement consumer

experiments.method: post-UpdateHID AxisL plus EmuLup activity bit for 60 frames
experiments.result: rejected: activating the GamePadDevice still does not feed snow.StmPlayerInput

conclusion: Do not use via.hid.GamePadDevice setters as the product movement adapter in Monster Hunter Rise. Keep external normal-input automation for developer acceptance only. The MVP product presents measured distance guidance and automatically recognizes the requested root and native continuation. A future fully automatic product adapter requires a separately scoped native XInput/REFramework plugin or a proven MHR-specific StmPlayerInput entry point.
